aria: Animated Short: Giannis Antetokounmpo, in his first game against Milwaukee, drives for a finger roll through contact with 3:46 left and makes the free throw for a 133–112 Heat lead after a 12–0 Bucks run. Heat win 137–130. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
